steps.title: Check the substrate
steps.detail: Feel the moisture deeper down and water only when the substrate is ready.

steps.title: Water slowly
steps.detail: Spread the water evenly over the substrate.

steps.title: Let it drain
steps.detail: Wait for the excess to leave the holes and empty the saucer.

tip: Use room-temperature water and match the amount to the pot size.

steps.title: Measure the dose
steps.detail: Follow the label without exceeding the indicated concentration.

steps.title: Dilute well
steps.detail: Mix the fertilizer into the water before applying it.

steps.title: Apply to moist substrate
steps.detail: Spread the solution without concentrating it in one spot.

tip: Do not fertilize a very dry, stressed or recently repotted plant.

steps.title: Look at the direction
steps.detail: Find the side growing towards the light source.

steps.title: Turn a quarter
steps.detail: Rotate the pot about 90° without twisting the stems.

steps.title: Keep the position
steps.detail: Put it back in the same spot and observe the response.

tip: Avoid rotating during flowering or acclimation.

steps.title: Prepare pot and substrate
steps.detail: Choose a slightly larger pot with drainage and a suitable mix.

steps.title: Check the roots
steps.detail: Lift the root ball and remove only dead or rotten roots.

steps.title: Keep the same height
steps.detail: Fill without packing too much and stabilise the plant.

tip: Avoid fertilizer and strong sun until the plant has settled.

steps.title: Disinfect the tools
steps.detail: Clean and dry the blades before starting.

steps.title: Choose where to cut
steps.detail: Find damaged parts or the correct node.

steps.title: Make a clean cut
steps.detail: Cut once without crushing the tissue.

tip: Do not remove too much foliage in a single session.

steps.title: Look at both sides
steps.detail: Check leaves for spots, deformations or pests.

steps.title: Inspect stems and substrate
steps.detail: Look at the crown, nodes, substrate and drainage.

steps.title: Record what you see
steps.detail: Note symptoms, affected areas and general condition.

tip: Temporarily isolate the plant if you suspect pests.

steps.title: Recreate the same framing
steps.detail: Use similar light, distance and angle.

steps.title: Look for changes
steps.detail: Observe new leaves, height, colour and growth.

steps.title: Add a note
steps.detail: Record the main differences and the plant condition.

tip: A consistent photo and a short note make comparison easier.

steps.title: Assess the destination
steps.detail: Check light, draughts, heat and space.

steps.title: Support pot and canopy
steps.detail: Lift from the base and support the stems.

steps.title: Place it safely
steps.detail: Check stability, saucer and orientation.

tip: After moving it, observe the plant before changing other care.

steps.title: Isolate the plant
steps.detail: Move it away from the others and identify the problem.

steps.title: Protect yourself and treat
steps.detail: Follow the label and apply only where needed.

steps.title: Clean and monitor
steps.detail: Disinfect tools and check how it evolves.

tip: Do not mix products or increase dose or frequency.
